description: Restructuring of the Housing Development Finance Corporation Bank of Sri Lanka and the Stage Mortgage and Investment Bank
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-11-10 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The Housing Development Finance Corporation Bank of Sri Lanka incorporated under the Sri Lanka Housing Development Finance Corporation Bank Act No. 07 of 1997, is a licensed specialized Bank listed on the Colombo Stock Exchange. Its primary objective is to provide housing finance and other services related thereto. The State Mortgage and Investment Bank, established under the State Mortgage and Investment Bank Law No.13 of 1975, is a fully Government-owned licensed specialized Bank, which provides mortgage loan facilities for housing-related purposes. Both these banks are relatively small financial institutions with a small market share. The Central Bank of Sri Lanka has indicated that the current business models of these banks are unsustainable due to their limited deposit-raising capacity, poor profitability, and inability to meet minimum capital adequacy requirements. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Planning and Economic Development to take necessary action, enabling the Bank of Ceylon to acquire the Government’s entire shareholding of the Housing Development Finance Corporation Bank of Sri Lanka to operate as a subsidiary of the Bank of Ceylon and enabling the People's Bank to acquire all shareholdings of the State Mortgage and Investment Bank to operate as a subsidiary of the said Bank, with the objectives of ensuring overall banking sector stability and safeguarding the interests of depositors by enhancing the operational efficiency of the Housing Development Finance Corporation Bank of Sri Lanka and the State Mortgage and Investment Bank, was approved by the Cabinet.
